hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Polished UI chrome (card shadows, styled controls, Tableau10 colors by group) elevates it above generic, but 300 random edge bundles converge into a dense hairball at center that obscures the hierarchy and makes the data unreadable in the default view.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: 300 random edges converging to the circle-pack center form an unreadable hairball in the default resting state — the interaction model (click/hover to highlight) is essential but not discoverable, and the 8-layout switcher plus tension/easing controls add significant UI overhead for what a viewer needs to extract a single insight.
